verdict.rationale: Canny documents an official MCP server, with secure sign-in, that can be added to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor. It supports both reading feedback (themes, ARR impact, roadmap) and taking actions (updating statuses, linking deals, replying to customers), and the probe confirms a dedicated MCP feature page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth technical docs such as a tool reference, endpoint URL, and setup steps beyond the marketing page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add Canny's MCP server to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with a secure sign-in. No API keys, no engineering.
Move ideas through your workflow without leaving your LLM. Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request.
official MCP server documented at https://canny.io/features/mcp
